title: centranthus calcitrapae var. orbiculatus
intro: Centranthus calcitrapae var. orbiculatus, commonly known as a type of valerian or centranthus, is a flowering plant species in the valerian family (Valerianaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing anxiety and insomnia, due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Centranthus calcitrapae var. orbiculatus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as valepotriates and valerenic acids, which possess sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
